Name: Ananias, the High Priest
Summary: Ananias the high priest ordered Paul struck during his defence before the Sanhedrin, and later came down to Caesarea with Tertullus to accuse Paul before Felix. He is distinct from Ananias of Damascus and from Ananias the husband of Sapphira.
KeyStory: Ananias ordered Paul struck on the mouth for speaking, and Paul answered with a prophecy he did not know he spoke.
LifeLesson: Office does not make a man just. Ananias used the high priesthood to strike a prisoner mid-sentence.
